excerpts.location: Section on pressure distribution (text preceding Figure 2), sentence 3
excerpts.quote: In the systemic circulatory system, the muscular small arteries and arterioles (or resistance arteries) account for 70% of the pressure drop.
excerpts.caveats: review statement; systemic data per figure legend from Fronek & Zweifach 1974 (mesenteric, skeletal muscle; species not stated in the text read)

excerpts.quote: The systemic capillaries and veins only account for 7% and 19% of the pressure drop, respectively
In the pulmonary circulation system, however, the pressure drop is evenly distributed among the pulmonary arteries and veins.
the pulmonary artery accounts for 30 ± 7% of the total pressure drop, whereas the pressure drop in the capillary and vein accounts for 17 ± 3% and 39 ± 13%, respectively.
excerpts.caveats: Figure 2 legend; 30+17+39 = 86%; data per Refs 8-10 incl. Brody 1968, Hakim 1982; pressure drop, not resistance
